page.layout: One page of text, one column, with the verse set as a stanza below the dedication. No margin notes. Running head at the top, page number at the top right.

l.i: Illinsculpta opus est sit cuiquam marmora
tuis[?] in miris, dux Casimire, piorum
defensa tuis iterumque iterūq; sub armis
tuis[?] hoc seruanda tuis si fata tulissent,

main_text.l: [?] Several words of the verse are printed in a damaged or worn state; readings marked [?] are uncertain.

page.notes: The verse stanza has a bracket at its left edge and a few ink spots and show-through, which are not printed text. The first word of the verse is partly obscured. "Ax." in the dedication is uncertain. The initial letter of the dedication heading is a large decorative capital and is partly worn.
